messages.content: 你能提供關於電影《全面啟動》的簡介，然後再幫我檢索有關同一部電影《全面啟動》的導演、演員、獎項等額外訊息，以及電影《黑暗騎士》的導演、演員、獎項等額外訊息嗎？

We'll just present the brief, then the details. We'll call the function accordingly.

We need to produce function calls in JSON format. The function name is movie_details_brief. We'll call it with arguments. For brief: title: "全面啟動", extra_info: false. For details: title: "全面啟動", extra_info: true. For Dark Knight: title: "黑暗騎士", extra_info: true.

We need to output the function calls. The system will handle them. We'll produce separate calls. The user wants the brief first. So we call for brief. Then we call for details for Inception. Then we call for details for Dark Knight. We'll output them sequentially.
